verdict.rationale: Viam documents remote, firewall-traversing access to deployed machines with no VPN or SSH (viam-docs-4, viam-docs-56). From the browser you can stream camera feeds, read sensor data, and visualize machine state in real time (viam-docs-5), and test components directly from the web UI (viam-docs-6). Programmatic inspection is also documented: GetMachineStatus explains why a resource is unhealthy, the machine API retrieves status remotely, and the CLI can call any machine API method from a shell (viam-docs-31, viam-docs-63, viam-docs-13). Missing for 10: no evidence of remote log viewing or streaming, no topic-style introspection of message streams beyond per-component API reads, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the remote debugging workflow.
